examples.text: João nasceu num hospital e morreu num hospital.
examples.en: John was born in a hospital and he died in a hospital.

examples.text: João morreu na mesma cama em que nasceu.
examples.en: John died in the same bed he was born.

examples.text: Todos que não eram um joão-ninguém estavam lá.
examples.en: Everybody who was anybody was there.

examples.text: Tom e João são bons amigos.
examples.en: Tom and John are good friends.
